storage.metric: compressed content-addressed transfer payload, NOT observed network traffic
storage.scope: Selected linux/arm64 manifest, config and layer objects; index retrieval excluded equally.

runtime_build_update.direction: Temurin 21.0.11+10 source image to Temurin 21.0.12+8 source image
runtime_build_update.scope: Includes any userland/source-image layer changes; not a JDK-binary-only or CVE-fix measurement.
runtime_build_update.optimized_control: Additional storage-only COPY --link images preserve application/dependency layers across base changes. Primary runtime comparison uses the original split-layer conventional image.

cleanup.retained: Shared base-image tags and BuildKit cache intentionally not pruned; raw data and downloaded kind remain in session files.

limitations: Single shared Docker Desktop VM; no significance or tail-latency claims.
Kubernetes ready/start timestamps have one-second resolution; Spring reports separate finer application timing.
Image-warm fresh JVMs, not cold-node or cold-registry startup.

Optimized conventional means layered application packaging, not the smallest possible runtime. Both primary variants use the same full JDK and source-image userland; JRE-only and jlink alternatives are not measured.
JVM PSS, per-container charge, and runtime-shim PSS are distinct accounting views.
RSS must not be summed as physical memory; neither design shares JVM heaps.
No custom AppCDS on either variant; default JDK CDS verified in process mappings.
Compressed OCI object bytes are not observed wire traffic, elapsed transfer time, or physical disk savings.
The JDK build-update experiment is separate from the primary matched-JDK comparison; it does not verify CVE remediation.
Deferred managed-tar/signer, Ratify/HPA, and Node UID-loss recovery work is not validated.

preflight.pilot: Four successful one-JVM readiness/memory/argv pilots were run while image preparation was still finishing. Excluded as preflight, not measured trials. Pilot collector failed after applications when a control-plane OCI field was omitted; fixed by applying OCI default false.
preflight.environment_preflight: A subsequent run was stopped during warmups before paired trials to explicitly equalize LANG, LANGUAGE, LC_ALL, JAVA_VERSION and verify live JDK identity. Logs and pod state retained separately.
preflight.primary_run: Two fresh warmups per variant follow preflight; 12 balanced seeded pairs and three four-JVM cohorts per variant. All failures, if any, retained. No rootfs repair; no page-cache eviction.
preflight.runtime_policy_update: Completed separate live Temurin 21.0.12+8 -> 21.0.11+10 -> 21.0.12+8 NodeProfile updates. Both application smoke Pods retained the same pinned Brewlet image and served readiness on the verified distinct JDK builds.
preflight.post_primary_tooling: Initial BuildKit rebase succeeded but did not create a Docker source-image alias. An explicit docker pull (added to the harness) exposed the exact source image for measured local-registry accounting; no primary trials were rerun or discarded.
preflight.optimized_rebase_control: A standard COPY rebuild changed dependency-layer digests when the base changed. We added actual COPY --link images as the optimized storage-only control, which reuses both dependency and application layers. The primary runtime images and measurements were not changed. Report the linked-rebase case, not standard-copy rebuild, as the optimized comparison.

runtime_policy_update.scope: post-primary experiment; not included in startup/memory trials
